meta.name: Track and alert congressional and insider trades via EDGAR, House.gov, and Gmail

parameters.content:
## Congress Trade Alert — EDGAR + House.gov (enriched)

### How it works

This workflow runs every 45 minutes to collect congressional trading disclosures from both House.gov PTR data and SEC EDGAR Form 4 feeds. It parses and combines both sources, filters out duplicates or stale filings, routes each new filing through source-specific enrichment, then records new items in Google Sheets and sends email alerts. If no new filings are found, the workflow stops without writing or notifying.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule trigger interval if 45 minutes is not appropriate for your monitoring cadence.
- Set up access for the ScrapeUnblocker/HTTP retrieval steps used to fetch the House disclosure landing page and EDGAR feed data.
- Verify the House.gov disclosure ZIP extraction code points to the correct current-year disclosure page and ZIP format.
- Review the EDGAR enrichment code and ensure any required SEC request headers, user agent, or rate-limit handling are configured.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and set the target spreadsheet/range used for deduplication and appending new filings.
- Connect Gmail credentials and configure the alert recipients, sender, and email content.

### Customization

You can adjust the recency gate, deduplication keys, alert thresholds, monitored filing types, email formatting, and schedule frequency to match your preferred trade-alert criteria.

## Scheduled workflow start

Starts the monitoring run on a fixed 45-minute cadence and fans out to the House.gov and EDGAR collection branches.

## Fetch House ZIP

Retrieves the House disclosure landing page, extracts the current-year ZIP URL, and downloads the disclosure archive.

## Fetch EDGAR feed

Fetches the SEC EDGAR Form 4 feed and parses the RSS/Atom entries into normalized filing records.

## Enrich filing details

Enriches EDGAR filings from Form 4 ownership XML, downloads and extracts House PTR PDFs, parses House PDF text, and merges the enriched source-specific results.

## Store and alert

Checks whether any enriched filings remain, appends new results to Google Sheets and sends Gmail alerts, or stops cleanly when there is nothing new.

nodes.name: Download House ZIP File
nodes.notes: Downloads the .zip via n8n's built-in HTTP helper (workaround for ScrapeUnblocker 403 on binaries). No HTTP Request node on canvas.

nodes.name: Download EDGAR Feed
nodes.notes: Fetches SEC EDGAR Form 4 Atom feed with a compliant User-Agent (ScrapeUnblocker 403s on SEC). Edit the contact email in the code.
